join.title: Use an invitation
join.summary: Scan a QR code or enter your code

provision.title: Set up my VPS
provision.summary: Create a VPN on your own server

hetzner.title: Create a Hetzner server
hetzner.summary: Rent a new VPS that sets itself up

backup.title: Restore this device
backup.summary: Adds a server back to this device. The server itself isn’t contacted.
backup.fileHint: Servers already on this device are never overwritten

error.picker: Couldn’t open the file picker. Try again.
error.restore: Couldn’t restore the backup. Check the file and password.

invitation.addsDevice: Adds a device to an existing member. Access stays the same.
invitation.trust: Join only if you expected this invitation from someone you trust.
invitation.error: Couldn’t verify this invitation. Ask for a new one.

join.title: Join a server
join.summary: Your private key is created on this device and never leaves it.
join.codeHint: Keep it private, like a password
join.error: This invitation didn’t work. It may be expired, used or revoked; ask for a new one.

recover.title: Recover Owner access
recover.summary: Disconnect the VPN first, then enter your recovery key.
recover.keyHint: Starts with sirr1. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
recover.confirmRevoke: Revoke all previous Owner devices and use up this key. Members keep access; Admins lose recovery permissions.
recover.replaceProfile: Replace this device’s saved profile for {{name}}
recover.error: Recovery didn’t finish. Try again with the same key.

setup.title: Connect your server
setup.summary: Sign in to your server over SSH to install SirinVPN.
setup.name: Server name

replace.title: Replace existing installation
replace.summary: Only if every Owner device and recovery key is lost

fingerprint.title: Verify your server
fingerprint.summary: Check this fingerprint in your hosting provider’s web console.
fingerprint.mismatch: If it doesn’t match, don’t continue. The connection may be intercepted.
fingerprint.replaceWarning: Replacing revokes every device, invitation and recovery key for this server.
fingerprint.pinned: SirinVPN created this key on this device and put it on the server before it first started, so there’s nothing to compare.

confirmReplace.title: Replace the existing installation?
confirmReplace.message: Every device, invitation and recovery key for this server stops working. Other software on the server isn’t affected.

installing.title: Setting up your server
installing.keepOpen: Keep SirinVPN open until this finishes.

success.title: Your VPN is ready
success.summary: {{name}} was added. Only this device has Owner access, so keep a recovery key.

error.unreachable: Couldn’t reach the server over SSH. Check the address and port.
error.network: Couldn’t check the server’s network. Try again.
error.install: Installation stopped safely and the server’s network is unchanged. Fix the issue and try again.

hetzner.title: Create a server on Hetzner Cloud
hetzner.summary: SirinVPN rents a Debian 13 server in your Hetzner account and installs itself. You never type an IP address or a password.
hetzner.tokenHint: Create a Read & Write token under Security → API tokens in your Hetzner Cloud project. It’s sent only to Hetzner and isn’t saved.
hetzner.tokenExpired: SirinVPN keeps the API token for only 10 minutes. Enter it again to continue.
hetzner.price: {{total}} {{currency}} per month: server {{server}} plus IPv4 address {{ipv4}}. Hetzner bills your account until you delete the server.
hetzner.priceNoIpv4: {{total}} {{currency}} per month for the server. Hetzner bills your account until you delete the server.

confirm.title: Create a Hetzner server?
confirm.message: {{type}} in {{location}} costs {{total}} {{currency}} a month until you delete it.

hetzner.waitingHint: This usually takes one or two minutes.
hetzner.created: {{name}} is running at {{ipv4}}. Choose your settings, then install SirinVPN.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteConfirm.message: The server and everything on it are removed from your Hetzner account.

hetzner.deleted: {{name}} was deleted from your Hetzner account.
hetzner.failedSummary: The server exists in your Hetzner account and is billed until it’s deleted. Delete it, wait again, or keep it to set it up later.
hetzner.kept: {{name}} stays in your Hetzner account. Its SSH host key is {{fingerprint}}.
hetzner.leaveWarning: A Hetzner server was created and is billed until it’s deleted. Leave anyway?
